rule: 60/20/20 of groups (round half to even), groups shuffled by numpy default_rng(seed)
group_key: group_id of the test catalogue (docs/wsp/atlas/SCHEMA.md): the test day or session

use.train: outcomes may be read by a model's author
use.validation: read only as an aggregate table from a look registered in docs/wsp/PROTOCOL.md beforehand
use.test: never read by an author or by an agent working for one; scored once by the evaluation lane
use.held: as validation: no outcome is read per test; scored only as an aggregate in a registered look

note: A test that is not in the catalogue yet belongs to the partition of its group id. A group id that is not listed here is held until this file's rule has been applied to it in a new file; this file is not rewritten.
